subject: CLAIM texture-opus (depth sampling): render_encoder.inc tegu_texture_bytes_per_pixel (+case 250) and tegu_texture_sampled_format (admit n2t depth 250/252); air_bridge.rs planner sampled_format admission line (~1599)
body: Depth16Unorm/Depth32Float sampled through depth2d (plain + compare) on the specialized path; n2t already packs Z16/Z32F descriptors and compare samplers. Depth attachment stores stay refused by pass admission (DontCare-only class), so sampled depth data comes from CPU uploads/blits; corpus users are AvatarKit/VFX/SceneKit/CoreRE/VectorKit (345 depth2d<float,sample>), not SpringBoard/CA. Test: authored gpu/tests/shaders/depth_sample_probe.ll.
